channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jordan Bell | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jordan Bell from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell, who has been out of the rotation early:

“I'm confident that he's going to make an impact on our team,but right now, things aren't going his direction.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell, Oct 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Bell:

“I'm hopeful he'll return for one of the three games on the the trip.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell, Feb 24, 2018. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Salah Mejri on Jordan Bell
item.description:
“At least he knows my jersey number, but I don’t know him. I don’t know him. I’m not trying to be silly, I’m serious. I don’t know who he is, for real. The only Jordan who plays basketball that I know is Michael Jordan.”

Salah Mejri on Jordan Bell, Jan 6, 2018. Source: DefPen.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Bob Myers, Jordan Bell
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steve Kerr on whether Jordan Bell's rotation spot is firm:

“If I don't put him out there in Miami, Bob (Myers) may fire me.”

Steve Kerr on Bob Myers, Jordan Bell, Dec 1, 2017. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Kerr on Jordan Bell's trash talk last night:

“It didn’t surprise me. The guy’s brash. It’s good for a rookie to come in here and be aggressive and confident. … I’m good with that.”

Steve Kerr on Jordan Bell, Nov 25, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.
